title: Claudia Sheinbaum Received Lee Jae-Myung, President of the Republic of Korea, at the National Palace
author: Emir Olivares and Alonso Urrutia
content:
_This article by[Emir Olivares and Alonso
Urrutia](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Emir%20Olivares%20y%20Alonso%20Urrutia)
originally appeared in the [September 24, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/24/politica/claudia-
sheinbaum-recibio-a-lee-jaemyung-presidente-de-corea-del-sur-en-palacio-
nacional), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Minutes before 10 in the morning, President Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo received the leader of the Republic of Korea, Lee Jae-Myung, at the main
door of the National Palace.

After greeting each other and observing a group of citizens who expressed
their support for the Mexican president, both entered the historic building.
The official welcoming ceremony for the Korean head of state was held in the
Patio de Honor.

The military band performed the national anthems of Mexico and the Republic of
Korea, as part of the reception protocol that this type of official visit
calls for.

Before going into the bilateral meeting they will hold, the two leaders posed
for the official photograph.

![Lee Jae-Myung and Claudia Sheinbaum on the red carpet at the welcoming
ceremony](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/2026-09-24-sheinbaum-lee-korea-02-welcome.jpg)Photo:
Germán Canseco

During the mañanera, the president indicated that they will discuss **trade,
cultural, and educational matters**. They will sign **a memorandum of
understanding** on that subject.

The head of state of the Asian nation is making an official visit to Mexico.
